853:t_63:5.en:
$$クラン$$
「As leader of the $$ピクシー$$ Platoon, I have to fight for those guys.」

853:t_63:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, come now~. Aren't you fighting for your beloved Mr. $$ミシェル$$?」

853:t_63:8.en:
$$クラン$$
「N-no, I take that back! It's not that I have no such intention at all, but as a Zentradi, that sort of thing...」

853:t_63:9.en:
$$クラン$$
「B-but... we are Zentradi who have awakened to culture! And if culture is love, then my fighting for $$ミシェル$$ too...」

853:t_63:10.en:
$$クラン$$
「N-no... as a leader, I have my responsibilities...」

853:t_63:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(It's amusing, so I'll keep watching like this, but... how long is this going to go on...?)

853:t_64:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Miss $$カナリア$$!」

853:t_64:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Who would you like to share this joy with?」

853:t_64:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see! The saying 'a mother is strong'... seeing you, Miss $$カナリア$$, I can truly feel it.」

853:t_64:7.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Exactly, AG. As long as it's to protect $$エディ$$, I fear nothing.」

853:t_64:8.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Naturally, a robot who may be plotting who knows what is nothing to me.」

853:t_64:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Ugh... I was going to act spoiled and call her 'Mommy~', but now I can't make a move...)

853:t_65:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「So this is how an ace pilot gets congratulated?」

853:t_65:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「No... I've always fought just as I was ordered, so I'm glad to be congratulated by someone like this...」

853:t_65:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$ブレラ$$ is no longer a combat machine, but a human being. I recommend that you live like one.」

853:t_65:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$ランカ$$ is a full-grown woman now, too. Please go find your own happiness, Mr. $$ブレラ$$.」

853:t_65:9.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「You're right... If I stay like this forever, $$ランカ$$ will worry too...」

853:t_65:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(It seems he still won't be able to leave Miss $$ランカ$$'s side for quite a while yet...)

853:t_65:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Well... they're siblings who were separated long ago. He can be a siscon for as long as he likes.)

853:t_66:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Not even close. To calm the blood pumping in me, a hundred or two hundred enemies aren't enough.」

853:t_66:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of Mr. $$竜馬$$... But a warrior needs rest, too.」

853:t_66:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I recommend that you relax when you're away from battle.」

853:t_66:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Then, to loosen myself up, come train with me, AG.」

853:t_66:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'll work off my stress on you.」

853:t_66:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-when you say that with that smile, it doesn't sound like a joke...」

853:t_67:4.en:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... to be congratulated by the guy least suited to words of blessing.」

853:t_67:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, don't say that. Please just be honest and enjoy this moment.」

853:t_67:6.en:
$$隼人$$
「Every enemy I shoot down brings us one enemy closer to peace... Thinking of it that way, it's a welcome thing.」

853:t_67:7.en:
$$隼人$$
「But the war isn't over yet. Until the day we win peace back, I'll keep striking down enemies.」

853:t_67:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(For all their differences, Mr. $$隼人$$ and Mr. $$竜馬$$ are the same at heart, aren't they...)

853:t_67:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(As expected of one of the warriors chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$... Please don't forget that you, too, are being drawn into an endless battle without even realizing it.)

853:t_68:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After talking with Mr. $$竜馬$$ and Mr. $$隼人$$, Mr. $$弁慶$$'s presence is a breath of fresh air.」

853:t_68:6.en:
$$弁慶$$
「If you don't lay a hand on $$渓$$, I'm a nice old guy.」

853:t_68:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's all right. Someone like Miss $$渓$$, who's so tomboyish...」

853:t_68:10.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Listen, AG! $$渓$$ may seem like a guy in some ways at first glance, but she's a kind, thoughtful woman!」

853:t_68:11.en:
$$弁慶$$
「What's more, if she did her hair and put on a little makeup...」

853:t_68:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Ah... this was supposed to end on a friendly note, and I went and stepped on a landmine myself...)

853:t_69:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「This much doesn't satisfy me. I'm aiming to be the ace of $c, and then the strongest man in the universe!」

853:t_69:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Compared to your days as the shadow boss of Atami, that's an incredible scale-up.」

853:t_69:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(...Honestly... at this rate, nothing has changed since his shadow boss days, has it...)

853:t_69:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$甲児$$, please pay no mind to a petty dimensional merchant like me, and keep aiming to be the strongest man in the universe.」

853:t_69:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(At times like this, the best thing is to flatter him and get through it quickly.)

853:t_69:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「I said... I can hear you.」

853:t_70:4.en:
$$さやか$$
「Thanks, AG. But don't come any closer than that.」

853:t_70:6.en:
$$さやか$$
「Of course I am. Considering everything you've done so far.」

853:t_70:7.en:
$$さやか$$
「I'm warning you, even the sob story won't work this time.」

853:t_70:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「B-but... it's your fault for being so charming, Miss $$さやか$$!」

853:t_70:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A beauty with a fine figure! And on top of that, both gentle and strong! There isn't a man alive who wouldn't fall for that!」

853:t_70:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The North Wind and the Sun... It seems my plan is going to succeed.)

853:t_71:4.en:
$$ボス$$
「Yeah! Now I'm officially the great ace of $c, in name and in fact!」

853:t_71:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In name and in fact... does that mean you were an ace in name only until now...」

853:t_71:6.en:
$$ボス$$
「Well, yeah. A talented hawk hides its butt, as they say.」

853:t_71:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Very well. I'll gracefully ignore the nonsense and ask the $$くろがね五人衆$$ about the real story.」

853:t_71:8.en:
$$ボス$$
「Ah, I was lying! Hold on, wait a minute!」

853:t_71:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't worry, Mr. $$ボス$$. I'm sure those gentlemen will train you so that you live up to the name of ace.」

853:t_72:4.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Mm... Words of praise are pleasant.」

853:t_72:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, since we're at it... Hey! Dandy of $$オリュンポス$$! Galactic Bro who guides humanity!」

853:t_72:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Truly the god among gods! The Fighting God of Light! A paragon of higher-dimensional life forms!」
